lines: The instant in the sheets, whether I drift off or not, is always the same.
I’m thinking of you.
Dreams are sad when you wake up from them.
The fireworks don’t rise today either.
The words I’ve sworn countless times in my heart soar upward.
I must not even forget a millimeter.
To everything that has a shadow shrouded in mist, whether it has shape or not.
I can’t entrust them.
A winged angel with triangular eyes hears the news of love.
It perches on my right arm and winks.
If you’re tired, why not stop?
Hanging from the summer constellations, I look down at the fireworks.
I love you this much; I can’t help it.
Hanging from the summer constellations, I look down at the fireworks.
I let my tears fall and extinguished the fire.
On the sand mound where the toes are aligned yet shifted, and on the bite marks of the apple.
What remains are fragments of memories.
When a slightly cold wind passes at my feet.
I want to give out lots of laughter.
A winged angel with triangular ears listens to sighs of love.
It points at me with wide eyes.
If you fall once or twice.
Hanging from the summer constellations, I look down at the fireworks.
I truly love you, but I can’t go back.
